en.condition: Thawed, seasoned boneless breasts, 6 oz each.
en.description: Includes refrigerated preparation, preheat, thickness guidance and a thermometer finish.

questions.question: Can I use this timing for a frozen or larger breast?
questions.answer: The first method is for thawed 6 oz breasts. The brined size choices are separate preparations, not a frozen-chicken conversion. Do not extend this clock using a weight or frozen-food formula.

questions.question: How thick should the chicken be?
questions.answer: The reference asks you to level the thick end but supplies no fixed thickness in inches. Keep the stated portion and an uncrowded layer; unusually thick pieces are outside this timing.

questions.question: Are marinating and preheating included in the timer?
questions.answer: No. Refrigerate the seasoned chicken for at least 30 minutes, then complete the displayed preheat procedure before starting the air-frying timer. The clock is per batch; rest the cooked breasts for 5 minutes.

questions.question: Does a finished timer mean the chicken is ready?
questions.answer: No. Measure each breast at its thickest center: poultry must reach 165°F. Continue cooking and recheck pieces that have not reached that temperature; color or time alone cannot confirm the finish.

zh.condition: 已解冻、调味后的无骨鸡胸肉，每块6盎司。
zh.description: 包括冷藏前处理、预热、厚度处理和中心熟度检查。

questions.question: 冷冻鸡胸肉或更大的鸡胸肉能照用这份时间吗？
questions.answer: 第一套做法适用于已解冻、每块6盎司的鸡胸肉。盐水浸泡的不同大小选项是另外的准备条件，不是冷冻做法。不要按重量比例或“冷冻多加几分钟”推算。

questions.question: 鸡胸肉需要多厚？
questions.answer: 参考做法只要求把较厚的一端轻拍平整，没有给出固定英寸厚度。保持注明的份量、单层摆放；明显过厚的肉块不在这份时间的适用范围。

questions.question: 腌制和预热算进倒计时了吗？
questions.answer: 没有。调味后至少冷藏30分钟，完成页面注明的预热再开始空气炸计时。计时按每批计算；达到安全中心温度后再静置5分钟。

questions.question: 计时结束就能吃了吗？
questions.answer: 不能只看时间。逐块检查最厚处中心达到165°F；未达到的继续加热并复查。外表颜色不能代替中心温度检查。

references.name: Feel Good Foodie: original seasoned preparation

en.condition: Fresh or thawed raw wingettes and drumettes, in a single layer.
en.description: Preparation, model-dependent preheat and a 165°F center check; not a frozen-wing timer.

questions.question: Does this include whole wings or frozen wings?
questions.answer: This method uses split wingettes and drumettes. Whole wings and frozen clusters are different starting conditions; the displayed clock is not a validated timer for those conditions.

questions.question: Can all 20 pieces go into one basket?
questions.answer: The ingredient list covers 20 pieces, not a required basket load. Keep an uncrowded single layer and cook in batches when needed. Dry the skin before coating; do not stack a second layer to keep the same clock.

questions.question: Do I need to preheat?
questions.answer: The original recipe makes preheating dependent on the appliance and gives no universal duration. Use your machine’s ready signal or manual. Do not invent a fixed preheat time from the cooking range.

questions.question: How do I check the wings are done?
questions.answer: Check the thickest meat with a food thermometer and reach 165°F. Avoid touching bone with the probe. Brown skin is not a center-temperature measurement.

zh.condition: 新鲜或已解冻的生鸡翅，分成翅中和翅根、单层摆放。
zh.description: 说明前处理、按机型预热和165°F中心温度检查，不把它当冷冻鸡翅时间。

questions.question: 整翅或冷冻鸡翅也能用这份时间吗？
questions.answer: 这份做法使用分开的翅中和翅根。整翅、结成团的冷冻鸡翅属于不同起始条件，页面时长不是这些情况的已验证计时。

questions.question: 20块鸡翅要一次全部放进去吗？
questions.answer: 20块是配料总量，不是每锅都要装下的数量。保持不拥挤的单层，放不下就分批。裹料前擦干表面，不要叠两层后仍沿用同一时长。

questions.question: 需要预热多久？
questions.answer: 原作者按设备情况决定是否预热，没有给出通用分钟数。按自己机器的就绪提示或说明书操作，不从烹饪时间反推出预热时长。

questions.question: 怎样确认鸡翅已经熟透？
questions.answer: 用食品温度计检查最厚的肉，探针避开骨头，中心达到165°F。表皮变色不等于中心已经达到安全温度。

en.condition: Frozen regular-cut fries; the first method uses 1 lb in single-layer batches.
en.description: Separate shoestring option, preheat, shaking and center checks; follow product directions first.

questions.question: Can I use the regular-cut clock for shoestring fries?
questions.answer: No. The shoestring choice is a separate reference. Keep the fries frozen and select the matching cut. Raw potato strips, wedges and leftovers are not covered by this frozen-fries method.

questions.question: Should I preheat for this timing?
questions.answer: This page follows the original recipe card’s preheated method. Its FAQ also discusses skipping preheat but provides no separate cold-start clock. Do not combine that change with the displayed preheated timing.

questions.question: Can I fill the basket with the whole bag?
questions.answer: The recipe quantity is not a command to fill the basket. Spread a single layer, batch when crowded and shake as instructed. A different bag, cut or appliance may need its own complete method.

questions.question: What should I check at the earlier time?
questions.answer: Check a fry is hot and soft through the center and crisp enough for you. Continue heating and recheck if the center is still cold or hard. Use any air-fryer instructions on the package as one complete method, rather than mixing its setting with this clock.

zh.condition: 袋装冷冻普通切型薯条；第一套以1磅总量、分批单层烹饪为参考。
zh.description: 细鞋带型另有选项；说明预热、摇篮和内部热透检查，优先遵循产品的完整做法。

questions.question: 普通切型和鞋带细薯条能共用时间吗？
questions.answer: 不能。鞋带细薯条有单独的参考选项。保持冷冻状态，并选择符合切型的做法；生土豆条、薯角和剩薯条复热不属于这份冷冻薯条条件。

questions.question: 这份时间是否需要预热？
questions.answer: 本页跟随原作者菜谱卡的预热做法。原文问答也讨论了不预热，但未另列冷启动时长，不应把这种改动与页面的预热计时混用。

questions.question: 整袋能一次倒进炸篮吗？
questions.answer: 配料总量不等于每锅装量。单层铺开，拥挤就分批，并按步骤摇篮。不同品牌、粗细和机器可能需要另一套完整做法。

questions.question: 到较早的检查时间，要看什么？
questions.answer: 取一根确认内部已热透、柔软，外部达到所需脆度；中心仍冷硬就继续加热并复查。包装若有空气炸锅说明，应整套采用，不把包装温度与本站时长拼接。

references.name: Air Frying Foodie: recipe card and preheat FAQ
Philips HD9200 manual, food table and airfrying

en.condition: Fresh boneless breasts, about 180 g each, with the thick end evened out.
en.description: Cold-start method with a halfway turn, size limits and a 75°C for 30 seconds center check.

questions.question: Is a thickness in centimetres required?
questions.answer: The reference gives an approximate weight and asks for even thickness; it does not specify a fixed centimetre value. Lightly even the thick end rather than making a thin cutlet. Larger or uneven breasts are outside this clock.

questions.question: Can I start with frozen chicken or preheat first?
questions.answer: The published method is for fresh chicken and starts without preheating. Frozen meat and a preheated basket are different starting conditions; this page does not supply a replacement clock for them.

questions.question: How do I decide the chicken is ready?
questions.answer: Check the thickest center reaches 75°C and stays there for 30 seconds. The visible no-thermometer observations below are fallback checks, not a way to measure center temperature; use a thermometer when available.

zh.condition: 新鲜无骨鸡胸肉，每块约180克，较厚的一端先轻拍平整。
zh.description: 冷启动、中途翻面；注明大小限制，并检查中心75°C保持30秒。

questions.question: 鸡胸肉要几厘米厚？
questions.answer: 参考做法给出约180克的重量和“厚薄接近”的处理要求，没有固定厘米数。只轻拍较厚的一端，不拍成薄鸡排；更大或厚薄明显不均的肉块不沿用这份时间。

questions.question: 冷冻鸡胸肉能直接用吗？能先预热吗？
questions.answer: 这套已发布做法使用新鲜鸡胸肉、不预热启动。冷冻肉和已预热的炸篮都是另一种起始条件，本页没有为它们提供替代计时。

questions.question: 怎样判断鸡胸肉可以出锅？
questions.answer: 最厚处中心达到75°C，并保持30秒。页面的无温度计观察只能作为补充检查，不能测出中心温度；具备条件时使用食品温度计。

references.name: Kitchen Sanctuary: original portion and preparation
Hong Kong CFS: cooking and reheating

en.condition: Thawed raw mid-joint wings; 500 g total, in uncrowded batches.
en.description: Refrigerated marinating, preheat, turning and a bone-avoiding center-temperature check.

questions.question: Can the timer start straight from frozen?
questions.answer: No. This published preparation starts with thawed mid-joint wings and requires at least 6 hours of refrigerated marinating. The air-frying clock excludes thawing, marinating and preheating.

questions.question: Does 500 g mean one basket load?
questions.answer: It is the total preparation quantity. This guide calls for 8–10 wings per uncrowded batch, starting skin-side down. Keep the same preparation and avoid stacking; the reference is not a weight-to-time formula.

questions.question: Where should I check the temperature?
questions.answer: Measure the thickest meat without touching bone. Reach 75°C and hold for 30 seconds. This is a food-center check, separate from the air fryer’s cooking setting.

zh.condition: 彻底解冻的生鸡中翅，总量500克，按不拥挤的单层分批。
zh.description: 包括提前冷藏腌制、预热、翻面和避开骨头的中心熟度检查。

questions.question: 从冷冻室拿出后能直接开始计时吗？
questions.answer: 不能。这套已发布做法先彻底解冻鸡中翅，并至少冷藏腌制6小时。空气炸计时不包含解冻、腌制和预热时间。

questions.question: 500克要一次全部放进炸篮吗？
questions.answer: 500克是准备总量。页面按每批约8–10个、不拥挤的单层摆放，开始时皮朝下。不要堆叠，也不要按重量比例换算时间。

questions.question: 中心温度该测哪里？
questions.answer: 探针进入最厚的肉并避开骨头，达到75°C后保持30秒。这里测的是食物中心，不是把炸锅设置成75°C。

references.name: Hong Kong CFS: cooking and reheating

en.condition: Frozen pre-fried fries, about 7 × 7 mm; 200 g, without thawing.
en.description: Philips HD9200 cold-start reference with no preheat, shaking and a hot, soft center check.

questions.question: Is this for raw potatoes or any thickness of frozen fries?
questions.answer: No. It is the published thin, pre-fried frozen-fries condition. The Philips manual lists 7 × 7 mm frozen fries separately from 10 × 10 mm homemade fries. Do not swap these conditions or copy a clock for thick wedges.

questions.question: Do I thaw, preheat or add oil?
questions.answer: This HD9200 reference starts cold, with frozen pre-fried fries and no extra oil. The manual says preheating is unnecessary. If the bag provides a different air-fryer method, follow the complete product instructions instead.

questions.question: Should every batch run to the longest time?
questions.answer: No. The manual’s range is a starting guide, not a guarantee for every brand or load. Check from the earlier time, shake as instructed, and look for a hot, soft center and golden exterior. Do not aim for a burnt or dark-brown finish.

zh.condition: 袋装预炸冷冻细薯条，约7×7毫米；200克，不解冻。
zh.description: Philips HD9200冷启动参考：不预热，中途摇篮，检查内部热透柔软。

questions.question: 生土豆条和不同粗细的薯条都能照用吗？
questions.answer: 不能。这是预炸冷冻细薯条条件。Philips说明书把约7×7毫米的冷冻薯条与10×10毫米自制薯条分别列出，不能互换，也不拿它替代粗薯角的时间。

questions.question: 要先解冻、预热或加油吗？
questions.answer: 这套HD9200参考使用冷冻预炸薯条、冷启动，不另加油；说明书注明不必预热。包装若提供不同空气炸锅方法，应整套按产品说明操作。

questions.question: 每锅都要烤到时间范围的上限吗？
questions.answer: 不需要。说明书范围是起点，不保证每个品牌或装量都相同。从较早时间开始检查，按步骤摇篮，确认内部热透柔软、外部金黄，不追求焦黑或深褐色。
